content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. We request reconsideration of the denied balance of 703.89 on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
